name: new_v1_family_personal_score_anchor_grab_user_and_day_v1
calibration_repetitions: For N shots per class, use native repetitions 1..N of each class from the same held-out subject and day; trials 6 and 7 always evaluate.
rule: For each class, mean the frozen source-model four-class probability vectors of its allowed labelled calibration trials. Softmax the negative squared Euclidean distance of the query source probability to class prototypes divided by fixed temperature 0.1; mix equal weights with the untouched source probability. Zero shots exactly reuse frozen source probability.
selection: All formulas, budgets, repetitions and weights frozen before results. No validation/final labels tune temperature, weight or arms. Day3 and previously inspected users are descriptive rather than new confirmatory cohorts.
scope: Public eight-channel 2048 Hz GRABMyo personal score-space follow-up for four independent new-v1 feature families against F0v2. Tests whether family ranking changes after one fixed personal score correction; not feature-space F7 anchors, per-channel normalization, physical-device performance or 250 Hz live recognition.
